# Tiny5 test font

`Tiny5-Regular.ttf` is copied unmodified from Google Fonts:

- Upstream path: `ofl/tiny5/Tiny5-Regular.ttf`
- Upstream repository: <https://github.com/google/fonts>
- Source project: <https://github.com/Gissio/font_tiny5>
- Source commit recorded by Google Fonts: `1d6e16fe1ffe3f91def8cf512ae45188503f7685f`
- SHA-256: `cb8168f80cfee2f47f6db59f2a7afbde31cdcdcdcf262e7a993e4d468a5bf4b0`
- Copyright: 2022–2024 The Tiny5 Project Authors
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL.txt`

The fixture is used only to exercise TrueType subsetting, Unicode coverage,
metadata retention, and WOFF2 generation. It is not included in example decks or
release output.
